title: Densities of Population vs. Populated areas
markdown:
| Size of town (Population) | Density of population per hectare |
| --- | --- |
| Up to 5,000 | 75-150 |
| Above 5,001 to 20,000 | 150-250 |
| Above 20,001 to 50,000 | 250-300 |
| Above 50,001 to 1,00,000 | 300-350 |
| Above 1,00,001 | 350-1,000 |

transcription.method: direct visual reading of rendered source page; no OCR
transcription.observations: Read each cell or formula and its printed context directly.

visual_recheck.method: separate second visual comparison with rendered source region; same assistant, not an independent reviewer
visual_recheck.observations: All five population ranges and density ranges including 350-1,000 rechecked.
